entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ah, you're back.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Well, I know it's a bit early, but I think[n]I'm gonna close up shop for the day.
entries.uk: Знаю, ще трохи рано, але, мабуть,[n]на сьогодні я зачинятимуся.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: We were so busy today, I ran out of all[n]my ingredients. I don't even remember[n]the last time that happened. Weird, huh?
entries.uk: Сьогодні був такий наплив, що в мене[n]скінчилися всі продукти. Навіть не[n]пригадаю, коли таке було. Дивно, га?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Anyway, don't forget to lock up.
entries.uk: Так чи інакше, не забудь замкнути.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Tomorrow's finally the day.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We've already secured the route[n]to the Treasure...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No problems there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: All we have to do now is wait.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sweet. We're gonna rock this shit!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Mm-hm!

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Oh, [fName]-senpai—[n]I wanted to ask you something...
entries.uk: О, [fName], я хотіла дещо[n]в тебе спитати...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Has Dr. Maruki contacted you yet?
entries.uk: Доктор Марукі вже виходив на зв'язок?

entries.en: Not yet.
No...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That means waiting really is all[n]we can do for now.
entries.uk: Отже, поки що нам справді лишається[n]тільки чекати.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Right.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: If anything comes up on my end,[n]though, I'll be in touch.
entries.uk: Але якщо в мене щось з'явиться,[n]я дам знати.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: See you tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: My apologies for calling so late.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: This is Maruki, by the way.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'm actually rather close by... Would[n]you mind lending me an ear?
entries.uk: Я, власне, зовсім поруч... Не проти[n]мене вислухати?

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: There's something important we need[n]to talk about.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: ...And, if you do intend to confront me,[n]I believe there's something you have to[n]give me first.
entries.uk: ...І якщо ти таки маєш намір протистояти[n]мені, гадаю, спершу ти маєш дещо[n]мені вручити.

entries.en: All right.
If we must.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: Thank you.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: I'll be at the café shortly.

entries.speaker: Maruki
entries.en: See you later.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I caught all of that.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just as we suspected, he knew he'd[n]have to get a calling card.
entries.uk: Як ми й підозрювали, він знав, що[n]йому доведеться отримати візитівку.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I have no clue how this meeting is[n]going to go down...
entries.uk: Гадки не маю, як пройде ця зустріч...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, ah... [fName]?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Just make sure you keep your guard up,[n]okay?
